verdict.rationale: Docs show the key works across several operating systems, with Windows login via Active Directory, Linux PAM and Android guides. They also name example services: Google, Facebook, Microsoft/Office 365, Nextcloud, Entra ID, SSH, OpenVPN and Thunderbird. However, there is no published compatibility catalog of supported services and no explicit browser-compatibility evidence, and one community report notes needing unsigned drivers on install. Missing for 10: a published service compatibility catalog, browser support coverage (Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge), macOS/iOS coverage, independent hands-on cross-platform corroboration.
